answer: The evidence carries a date, so a proof fired yesterday cannot claim to be a year old. The threshold charges in days as well as coins: 7 days to cure a proof, and a farm cannot cure 346 proofs any faster. The willow points at a person the farm never met, the sonnet points at a sum the farm never owned, the wharf points at a year the farm never lived. When the panel doubts everything else, Altarpiece painter wet-plaster medallion warrant brushed onto the baptistery dome still stands, and its standing is each wet-plaster medallion is a year of plaster logs in the chapel ledger.
